Poco X6: the cheapest of the three with a bright AMOLED screen and a solid chip. Its software comes with extra pre-installed apps.
Redmi Note 13 Pro: the pick for photos, for ₹1,000 more. It can heat up in long gaming sessions.
iQOO Neo 9 SE: the strongest chip and fastest charging, best for gaming. Low-light photos are average.

All prices and specs come from one buying guide, updated Thu 22 Oct 2026. Shop prices may differ, so check the final price before you buy.

Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
3:44 PM

Here's a relaxed 3 day Jaipur plan for your parents: sights in the morning, a rest after lunch, and a gentle evening.

Day 1: Forts and old city

Morning: Amer Fort. Go early to beat the heat and crowds, and take a jeep up instead of climbing.
Midday: Photo stop at Jal Mahal, then lunch and rest.
Evening: Hawa Mahal from a rooftop café, then a slow walk through Johari Bazaar.

Day 2: Palaces and culture

Morning: City Palace and Jantar Mantar, both close together.
Afternoon: Rest at the hotel.
Evening: Albert Hall Museum when it's lit up, then dinner with Rajasthani thali.

Day 3: Easy day and shopping

Morning: Birla Mandir, then a visit to Patrika Gate for photos.
Afternoon: Block-print and jewellery shopping at Bapu Bazaar.
Evening: Dinner at Chokhi Dhani for folk music and food, if they have energy.

Book a hotel near the old city so the days stay short, and hire one car for all three days. Do your parents find stairs or long walks hard? I can then swap in easier options.
